description: This PHP file defines the LengthClass model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages CRUD operations for length class records in the database, including descriptions in multiple languages, and handles caching and filtering features. The class is located within the namespace Opencart\Admin\Model\Localisation and extends the base Model class from Opencart's system engine.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: A model class handling CRUD operations related to length measurement units, including multilingual descriptions, within the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addLengthClass
methods.description: Creates a new length class record in the database and adds multilingual descriptions.

methods.name: editLengthClass
methods.description: Updates an existing length class record and its descriptions in the database.

methods.name: deleteLengthClass
methods.description: Deletes a length class record and its associated descriptions.

methods.name: deleteLengthClassesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all length class descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getLengthClass
methods.description: Retrieves a length class record along with its description for the current config language.

methods.name: getLengthClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of length classes, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalLengthClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of length class records for a given language filter.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a multilanguage description for a specific length class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specified length class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific length class description for a given language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a particular length class ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all length class descriptions for a given language.

methods.name: getDescriptionByUnit
methods.description: Fetches a length class description based on its unit string for the current configuration language.
